فِنْدِيرٌ (S, K) and فِنْدِيرَةٌ (S, M, K) A great mass of rock that projects, or juts out, (تَنْدُرُ,) from the head of a mountain: (S:) what is thus called is short of (دُونَ) what is termed فِدْرَة [in relation to a mountain]; (M, K;) by which may
be meat دون in respect of place and projection, not in respect of size. (TA.) [See also فِدْرَةٌ and فَادِرَةٌ: and see more in art. فندر.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
